newsitem.title: UK: Cairn Energy in Bangladesh gas sale deal.
newsitem.headline: Cairn Energy in Bangladesh gas sale deal.

text.p: Cairn Energy Plc said it reached heads of agreement to sell gas from the Bangladesh offshore Sangu field to the Bangladesh Oil, Gas and Mineral Corporation (PetroBangla), one of the biggest gas users in the area.
Cairn expects the agreement to be finalised in January 1997.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed, but a Cairn spokeswoman said the amount of gas involved was "substantial".

Delivery of first gas from Sangu is scheduled for early 1998. "We are delighted that with assistance of PetroBangla we have together achieved this important milestone," said Cairn's chief executive Bill Gammell.
